//: This file contains all LLM-specific parameters for better control
All parameters are model-agnostic and work with any Celeste-supported provider

default.description: Default parameters for all generation types

story_plan.description: Parameters for story plan generation (null max_tokens = let model decide)

chapter.description: Parameters for chapter generation (null max_tokens = let model decide)

gemini-2.5-flash.notes: Good balance of speed and quality for storytelling

gpt-4o-mini.notes: Larger context window, good for complex stories

claude-3-5-sonnet.notes: Excellent for creative writing and complex narratives

pricing.//: Pricing in USD per 1M tokens (input / output). Updated Dec 2024.

gemini-2.5-flash.notes: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash - Best value for speed

claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022.notes: Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet - Best for creative writing

claude-3-5-haiku-20241022.notes: Anthropic Claude 3.5 Haiku - Fast and affordable

mistral-medium-latest.notes: Mistral Medium - Good quality, competitive pricing

usage_tips.max_tokens: Set to null to let the model decide response length automatically
usage_tips.temperature: Lower (0.3-0.7) for more deterministic output, higher (0.8-1.2) for more creativity
usage_tips.model_switching: Just change the model_path in default.yaml - all other settings remain compatible
usage_tips.pricing: Prices are estimates in USD per 1M tokens. Actual costs may vary. Check provider websites for latest pricing.
